description: Structured hints the extraction schema cannot express, from the research drafts (summaries and conditions clipped to 25 words). An anchored hint cites a quote of at most 25 words that resolves in the captures (research-quote: the research quoted it; keyword-search: a capture sentence with the rate and a keyword, which a verifier must confirm says what the hint says). Unanchored hints cite the research. draftNotes record what drafting dropped.
